so_what: This is the one league where full PPR actively changes today's targets: Caleb Douglas (MIA) and Devaughn Vele (NO) are worth roughly double the reception credit they'd carry elsewhere, and your bench has zero WR depth to fall back on.

Your own roster carries the week's most concrete injury watch -- Chig Okonkwo's hamstring leaves an unproven Terrance Ferguson as your only TE if he sits Week 2; Mike Gesicki (unrostered) is a real streaming fallback.
Zay Flowers, your other injured starter, reads as 'not serious' -- a monitor situation, not a waiver need, but worth confirming alongside Okonkwo given no bench WR cushion.

The Falcons' QB uncertainty and the McCaffrey/Black split are both genuinely two-sided trade-leverage stories here (Robinson/London and McCaffrey/Black each split across different rosters), unlike the other two leagues.
This is the shallowest wire of the three leagues (84 startable RB/WR slots, 210 rostered) -- expect names to clear faster and thinner all season.
Week 2 games run Thursday Sept. 17 through Monday Sept. 21; the next brief lands next Tuesday building on this baseline.
